title: Pitt #1 Image Comics January 1993 Dale Keown First Issue
conditionDescription: Bright cover, light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Pitt #1 (January 1993), Image Comics - "Rippin' 1st Issue!" by Dale Keown. $1.95 cover price.

Back cover: Entertainment This Month mail-order ad (Spawn #8, Darker Image, StormWatch, Valiant).

Condition: bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
